title: Metahuman vs Mutant: DC and Marvel Powers
script: This is a Metahuman. This is a Mutant. So what's the difference? Most people think these terms describe the same type of superpowered individual. They're not. In DC, Metahumans gain powers through external factors like genetic anomalies, alien exposure, or scientific experimentation. In Marvel, Mutants are born with the X-gene, developing powers naturally at puberty. That's why Flash *became a Metahuman from the S.T.A.R. Labs explosion*, while Wolverine *was born a Mutant*. Follow for more.
